zh-CN.title: 广场素材加载更迅速
items: 浏览过的广场图片与视频缩略图现在会保存在本地媒体缓存中
再次进入广场时可直接复用缓存，减少重复请求与素材闪烁

en.title: Faster Square media loading
items: Viewed Square images and video thumbnails are now retained in the local media cache
Returning to Square now reuses cached media to reduce repeated requests and visual reloads
